title: Seeds in the Granary
text: Overnight, every House's granary has filled with pale seeds mixed in with the grain, soft as skin and faintly warm. Put to the ear, they hum. Planted, the farmers say, they would feed the city twice over. The priests say to burn them, grain and all.

options.label: Plant the pale seeds; a city fed twice over is worth a little humming.

outcomes.text: The fields come up green in a week and gold in a month, and the harvest is enormous. At night something hums a lullaby in the furrows, and your youngest have started humming it too.

options.label: Burn your grain, seeds and all, as the priests say.

outcomes.text: The granary burns with a sound like a crowd sighing. Your House goes hungry, but nothing hums in your Seat at night.

options.label: Sell the mixed grain on to the other Houses and let them do the worrying.

outcomes.text: Not knowing, they pay well. You keep your conscience in the vault with the gold.

options.label: Sift out what seeds you can and keep the grain.

outcomes.text: The servants sift for a week but miss some. The grain that is left tastes of milk.

together.text: No House burns its granary. The city's bread hums faintly in the oven; the Rift is warm to the touch.
